The duplicated, unread `approval` key in join-policy.yaml is gone -- approval mode was never that file's fact to state. The real one is federation-core.yaml's `policy.management_request_approval: explicit`, which check_policy() genuinely enforces; nothing generates the automatic alternative. | S3.6 | Version fact 3 -- the management API is the sanctioned integration point | **implemented** | Session-authenticated admin REST API throughout; no UI scripting anywhere. | `apps/console/xroad.py` (`X-XSRF-TOKEN`) |
